name: Ulanzi TC002 (AWTRIX NG)
description: Show your FiestaBoard pages on a Ulanzi TC002 running AWTRIX NG, as an app in its rotation, over your local network.
author: Oliver Rummeyer

host.title: Clock address
host.description: The TC002's IP address or local name on your network (for example 192.168.1.60 or awtrixng-a1b2c3.local). Use Find my clock, or type it in.

app_name.title: App name
app_name.description: The name of the app the board shows up as in the clock's rotation. Letters, digits, - and _, at most 32. Empty: FiestaBoard.

show_on_change.title: Show on change
show_on_change.description: Switch the clock to the board whenever its page changes, so the change and its transition are seen. Off, the board waits for its turn in the rotation.

duration_s.title: Display time
duration_s.description: Seconds the board stays on screen in the rotation. Leave empty for the clock's own app duration.

tile_gap.title: Tile style
tile_gap.description: Gaps keeps the one-pixel line between neighbouring color tiles, as on a split-flap board. Seamless lights it when both are the same color, so a row of tiles reads as one solid bar.

block_padding.title: Block padding
block_padding.description: 1 pixel grows the background of highlighted text one pixel on every side, so the letters never touch its edge.

fade_style.title: Fade style
fade_style.description: How the Fade transition looks. Through black streams six pixel frames through black in about a second. Blend cross-fades the two pages.

username.title: User name
username.description: Only when the clock's web UI asks for a password (authEnabled in AWTRIX NG's settings).

password.title: Password
password.description: Only when the clock's web UI asks for a password.

native_rotation.title: Native collection rotation
native_rotation.description: Let the clock rotate timed collections and use its left/right buttons to change pages. Requires FiestaBoard's native playlist support. Single pages use one slot; random/rule collections keep FiestaBoard rotation. Off preserves the existing behavior.

firmware_transition_override.title: Override firmware transitions
firmware_transition_override.description: Apply the selected settings to the whole TC002, including other native apps. Off leaves device settings untouched. This is separate from FiestaBoard page animations.

firmware_transition_effect.title: Firmware transition effect
firmware_transition_effect.description: Used when the clock switches native apps. The selected effect must be advertised by the connected firmware.

firmware_transition_direction.title: Firmware transition direction
firmware_transition_direction.description: Reverse movement without changing app order; symmetric effects are unchanged.

firmware_transition_duration_ms.title: Firmware transition duration (ms)
firmware_transition_duration_ms.description: Blank uses the device setting. Zero switches instantly. Applies device-wide when the override is on.

firmware_auto_rotation.title: Automatic firmware rotation
firmware_auto_rotation.description: Off stops automatic native-app rotation; buttons and API navigation still work. Does not stop FiestaBoard updates.

actions.label: Find my clock
actions.description: Looks for an AWTRIX NG clock on your local network. Only devices on your network are contacted.

subnet.title: Network to search
subnet.description: Optional, for example 192.168.1.0/24. Leave empty to search the network FiestaBoard is on.

hint_host.title: Address you opened FiestaBoard at
hint_host.description: Optional. The network of this address is searched first.
